note: Shared editorial modules (chapter '*') used by every palace chapter. They carry the argument structure of the essay: framing of the focus palace, one paragraph per theme (system frame -> lead book reading -> reinforcing readings -> brightness -> counter-reading -> how the two relate), cross-palace links, the opposite palace as environment, timing, limits and synthesis. Every book claim enters through a slot filled by the planner from fired verified rules with their pages; the connective sentences here add no verdict of their own (validator: unsupported_evaluation). Chapter files add only what is specific to one chapter. All modules are drafts until an expert approves them (tools/interpret/editorial.ts).
